system.description:
Your illusions shake off their stillness and take on a semblance of life — figures that walk, water that drips, a knife that darts through the air, a man who comes apart and knits himself back together.

First craft an illusion with a lesser Chimerstry power, then spend a single Blood Trait to give it animation, causing it to move in one specific pattern you desire; spending a full turn in concentration lets you change that pattern at no extra cost. You must remain present for the illusion to sustain itself. Retest with Subterfuge.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
